text.card: A red giant 1,462 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.92 solar masses and 7.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,737 K at its surface.
